title: Bali Couples Holiday with Flights
alt: Handara gate in the hills at Bedugul, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Bedugul and Kintamani
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the terraces and the jungle swing.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights inland with a candlelight dinner on arrival, the Bedugul lake temples and a coffee plantation day up to Kintamani.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet pool hotel walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Water sports with Uluwatu temple
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa in the morning, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu in the late afternoon.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your free day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa in Kuta.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with a water sports and Uluwatu day, a free day on the beach and a spa hour before you fly home.

day_titles.1: Flight to Bali and a dinner

1: Flight from Delhi to Denpasar, included in your package
Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
Candlelight dinner for two in the evening
2: Breakfast, then north to the Handara gate for photographs
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Evening back in Ubud at your own pace
3: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Kuta
Check in at your hotel near the beach
Rest of the day free on the south coast
Optional: Kuta Square, the art market or a sunset walk
5: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
Optional: the Kecak fire dance at the temple
6: Breakfast and a free day on the coast
An hour of Balinese massage for two at a nearby spa
Optional: a surf lesson on Kuta beach with an instructor
Optional: grilled seafood on the sand at Jimbaran
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Flights included and a candlelight dinner on the first night. Couples land, eat well and sleep, and the trip starts right.
expert.tip: Three nights in each base is the sweet spot for a week. Keep the sixth day completely free, it is the one couples thank us for when they get home.

summary: Seven days for two with return flights, three nights in Ubud for a candlelight dinner, the Bedugul lake temples and Kintamani, then three nights in Kuta with water sports, Uluwatu, a free beach day and a couples massage.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; candlelight dinner; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; water sports with Uluwatu; Balinese massage for two.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
